text:
maria: Observed a streaming latency regression on /v1/stream/generate after last release (merge 4f2c9b). Tail p99+ spiked ~30-45ms on tool-calling flows. Perf CI flagged too.
perf-ci-bot: [perf] Perf regression detected: +17% p99 token latency on staging - build #4521. Compare: https://ci.redwood/perf/4521
kenji: which change looks suspect? last merged PR was "stream-proto-envelope" by @alyssa
maria: yeah, the PR added a small "chunk_metadata" proto message wrapper and switched to server-side protobuf marshal per-chunk. CPU profile attached.
maria: Profiling snippet:
```txt
# cpu flame (short)
goroutine 12345 @ server.writeChunk
- proto.Marshal 42% (allocs)
- writer.Lock 12%
- encodeChunkHeaders 8%
- net.write 20%
```
devon: proto.Marshal per-chunk is suspicious. We used to pre-serialize payload or use netstring. Maybe we reintroduced locking in writer path.
alyssa: I added chunk metadata to support tool-calls so frontends can correlate tool outputs. I thought marshaling cost was negligible.
maria: On high concurrency it isn't. Observed serialization latency scales with active streams. Example microtrace:
```json
{"trace_id":"abc","span":"writeLoop","dur_ms":6.7}
{"span":"proto.Marshal","dur_ms":4.9}
{"span":"writer.Lock","dur_ms":1.2}
```
kenji: Can we reproduce locally with load test? run:
```bash
./tools/loadtest --concurrency 200 --route /v1/stream/generate --enable-tools
```
devon: I bisected on staging: culprit commit 4f2c9b -> adding ServerChunk wrapper. Reverted locally and tail returned to baseline.
maria: perf-ci-bot posted commit that caused failure: https://ci.redwood/commit/4f2c9b
ops-bot: Rolling back 4f2c9b on staging now.
alyssa: ugh sorry, missed the perf test. happy to help fix.
kenji: Short-term: revert the merge and cut a hotfix. Long-term: change to pre-serialized chunk buffer and offload proto.Marshal to goroutine pool or use zero-copy.
maria: Quick patch idea: keep new metadata but marshal metadata+payload as one precomputed []byte when chunk is ready instead of per-Write. Also reduce lock scope: assemble bytes then lock once for net.Write.
devon: I'll open PR with revert + benchmark and add CI perf regression test that runs a small concurrency streaming scenario.
maria: Created issue Redwood-4291 for follow-up: async-serialize-stream-chunks, and I'll attach microbenchmarks.
kenji: Awesome. Add a canary rollout with rate limit to verify after patch.
alyssa: thanks all — will review revert PR.
maria: tl;dr: root cause = per-chunk protobuf marshal + writer locking on hot path; action = revert + async/precompute serialization + perf test + follow-up ticket.
kenji: :thumbsup:
perf-ci-bot: Perf baseline job queued: https://ci.redwood/perf/job/4530
ops-bot: Staging revert completed at 1772501540, monitoring.
maria: Monitoring shows p99 back to normal after revert. Will track release bump.
devon: PR #4825 opened: revert + perf test + TODO notes. https://git.redwood/pr/4825
alyssa: I'll ship a smaller patch that preserves metadata but uses zero-copy envelope. Follow up in #4826.
maria: thanks everyone. moving to blocker's queue until merge.
